title: Clo Virtual Summit 2024
description:
Did you miss the premiere of our CLO VIRTUAL SUMMIT 2024? Don’t worry; you can watch the full event right here! Whether you're an individual user, a student, or simply curious about CLO, don’t miss the chance to explore our Summit. Discover success stories from some of our most outstanding users, learn where to find all the learning and support resources available, and get insights from our 3D specialists. Plus, get a first-hand look at the latest features and enhancements that CLO has to offer.

0:00 Intro 
03:35 Martina Ponzoni – Exploring Multidisciplinary CLO Careers
13:52 CLO Support Resources
21:10 Gongxu Sun – Perfect Boy: An Inspiring Collection
26:50 CLO Innovations 2024
37:36 Aitana Basquiat – The User of CLO as an Artistic Tool
47:10 Learning Resources
49:09 Connect
55:26 CLO Vision for the Future
